description: The IDE-IGP is the spatial data infrastructure of the Geophysical Institute of Peru, giving public access to the institute's geophysical geographic information. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists its components, a geographic viewer, web services, a metadata catalogue, open data and applications with queries, geoprocessing, layer intersection and map printing, plus dashboards for seismic and volcanic monitoring; it features seismic-geotechnical soil zoning maps for Piura, Tacna, Arequipa and Moquegua that describe the dynamic behaviour of soils during earthquakes, built from seismic methods (H/V, MASW, MAN) and electrical, gravimetric, geological, geomorphological, geodynamic and geotechnical data. Coverage is Peru, with zoning maps for selected cities. Access is free; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: the open data catalogue and service list were not opened, and microzonation covers only some cities. It supports earthquake hazard exposure and site amplification inputs for fragility studies of buildings and infrastructure in Peruvian cities. Related record: data-jicamarca-radio-observatory-databases is another IGP data source.
